sampling: All40 complete-wake S01 records; same cyclic36 ordinary-negative and all4 echo record selection. Seeded shuffle assigns18 ordinary+2 echo to prefix contexts and18+2 to regular contexts. Five batches each8 wakes+4 prefix negatives+4 regular negatives; each recording appears once. Prefix endpoint index(epoch+shuffled prefix position)%4 yields5 contexts per prefix duration. Regular10 use minimum-RMS regular context per selected recording and10 rotate original deduplicated endpoints. No class weights.
normalization: UNCHANGED from v1: first REGULAR context of each125 S01 recording; no prefix contexts or S02 statistics; exact mean/std parity assertion
padding: Shared past-only two-second context with left-zero padding; endpoints deduplicated within recording
stopping_monitor: S02 balanced recording-weighted cross-entropy: mean window CE within recording; mean recordings within each binary class; average the two class means

qualification.selection: Only qualifying candidates; minimize misses, then false events, then prefer higher threshold; otherwise null threshold
qualification.scope: Short SPK01 validation screen only; not a production false-activation guarantee or held-out test

echo_semantics: Reviewed wake-free narration is binary nonwake, with echo flag retained; no claim about playback saying Kural
quiet_selection: 9 ordinary+1 echo regular records use their minimum-RMS regular context; labels solely from reviewed whole-record absence. Remaining9 ordinary+1 echo regular records rotate original candidates.
validation_monitor: UNCHANGED regular S02 contexts only; no prefix expansion or diagnostic validity mask
context_validity_gate: Diagnostic only; never used for fitting or primary all20 S02 evaluation
silence_controls: Report mathematical digital silence and S01 reviewed-negative prefixes from best checkpoint; diagnostic only, no synthetic-silence fitting or changed qualification
